_: The core's own size marks for scripts/reading-size.mjs, as a project's checks/sizes.json (tasks/cleaning.md, "Size asks; a reader who reads less answers"; #469). Only "split" and "past" bind here: what each role reads at its start is held by scripts/size.mjs's caps, so "read" is empty. The dated records are skipped, cut by month where at all.

.github/workflows/tests.yml.why: A session reads the one step it changes, found by its name; split into workflows, each would be a job of its own, billed by the minute on a private repository's free plan, and its suites share one matrix.

AGENTS.md.why: Its rules that only some tasks break move to modules read on need in #845.

README.md.why: Past the large file mark, it is read by the section a task needs, found by searching, never whole (roles/shared/how-to-work.md, "Read little"), so no split lets a session read less; GitHub shows it whole as the repository's front page, to people.

tests/pruning-test.mjs.why: #895: its section on the rules with no holder moves to a test of its own.

scripts/choices.mjs.why: #912: the records' check a pull request runs apart from the signs the scheduled look reads.

tasks/choices.md.why: #913: the rules of a move off what a project stands on apart from those of making a record.

tests/choices-test.mjs.why: #912: split as its script is, the records' check apart from the look's signs.

scripts/csharp-tree.mjs.why: #884: the text the parser reads (the preprocessor, C# 14's extension headers) apart from the reading of the tree.

scripts/holders.mjs.why: #888: the reader of a project's own list apart from the core's own list.

scripts/pr-description.mjs.why: #888: each line's check in a file of its own beside a short reader.

scripts/pruning.mjs.why: #888: the list it prints apart from what it reads from the host and its record.

tasks/game-design.md.why: #441: the game rules split into a base and a file for each kind (#484, points 6 and 7).

tests/steps-test.mjs.why: #916: a file for each reader its sections test.

scripts/strength.mjs.why: #920: the verdict on a run apart from the run on a project.

scripts/read-total.mjs.why: Whoever changes how the total is counted reads its tree reader, its readers, its cut and its conditions together, each calling the others; split, that session opens more files and reads no less, and no other task reads it.

scripts/reading.mjs.why: The start hook runs it from git with no file beside it, so it stands alone (its opening says so): no part can be moved to a file of its own.

scripts/size.mjs.why: #892: the record of its caps' raises apart from the caps and the measure.

scripts/security-review.mjs.why: #931: along what it reads, Codex's summary, who counts as a reviewer, what a review stands for, floor rule 3's count and the status posted.

scripts/shape.mjs.why: #884: along its sections, the survey apart from the baseline and the verdict.

scripts/state-report.mjs.why: Its sections are other scripts' already (holders, pruning, cited, read-total, merge-line); what stands is the one body that sets them in order, which whoever changes a section reads.

tests/code-shape-test.mjs.why: #884: the measures of code-shape.mjs apart from the JavaScript functions read on the parser.

tests/holders-test.mjs.why: Split by the reader each case tests in #852: its archive cases apart from the rest, and a project's own rules and share apart from the core's.

tests/hostile-configs-test.mjs.why: Split by the reader each case tests in #852.

tests/hostile-pr-changes-test.mjs.why: Split by the reader each case tests in #852.

tests/init-test.mjs.why: Its cases run on the one scratch project it writes from the starter kit; split, each file would write it again, adding to the suite's time (tasks/tests.md), and every case reads that setup.

tests/issue-terms-test.mjs.why: One script's cases (issue-terms.mjs): its texts, edits and terms file, all on the one fake host it sets up; split, each file would set that host up again, and a session changing the script reads every case of it.

tests/look-test.mjs.why: Split into the look's tests and the state report's in #852.

tests/pr-description-test.mjs.why: #888: its cases split with the script, each line's check's cases beside it.

tests/reading-test.mjs.why: Split by the part of reading.mjs each case tests in #852.

tests/shape-readers-test.mjs.why: #884: by language, each reader's cases apart.

tests/shape-test.mjs.why: #884: along its sections, in step with scripts/shape.mjs.

tests/size-test.mjs.why: One script's cases (size.mjs) and the size.yml steps that run it, on the one scratch core it sets up; split, each file would write it again, adding to the suite's time (tasks/tests.md), and a session changing the script reads every case.

scripts/step-checks.mjs.why: #919: split by step, so the session that changes one step's check opens that step's file alone.

scripts/check-configs.mjs.why: #919: the reading of a workflow's runs apart from the reading of each check's config; the steps' readers, which import it, move first.

scripts/agent-tools.mjs.why: #919: the readers of each agent tool's configuration apart from the check that lists them.

tests/agent-tools-test.mjs.why: #919: split with agent-tools.mjs, a file of cases for each tool's configuration.

tests/core-path-test.mjs.why: #919: its cases for a core a library carries, and for the commands its hooks run, move to a file of their own.
